raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Customers with numeric region codes '01'-'04' in raw_customers were not translated to region names, so silver_customers carries raw codes. raw_region_map provides an exact 1:1 code-to-name lookup for those four codes, so joining it fixes the domain values and the downstream gold_region_daily table.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.7, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_customers": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_customers AS SELECT c.customer_id, coalesce(m.region_name, upper(c.region)) AS region FROM raw_customers c LEFT JOIN raw_region_map m ON c.region = m.region_code;"}}
